verdicts.criticalReason: PR #0 introduces a critical security vulnerability by removing authorization checks (isProtocolAccessAuthorized) in DocumentController.java, exposing confidential PROTOCOL documents to unauthorized users, and deleting associated security tests in DocumentSecurityTest.java. Additionally, the PR diff deletes Flyway migrations, privacy token repositories, and alters backend auth controllers, directly contradicting the PR DoD requirement that the diff contain only files needed for the frontend UI slice.
